predictions.reasoning: This market prices the probability of a specific candidate (Glenn Youngkin) winning an election that is roughly three years away. A short-term swing in this implied probability carries essentially no information that liquid public markets would price over a 12-hour window. There is no policy resolution, no imminent event, and the candidate has not even declared. Any mapping to SPY is speculative at best; even if Youngkin were seen as market-friendly (pro-business Republican governor), the horizon is far too long and the probability too low for a measurable near-term asset move. Included only to state that the honest read is no tradable signal.

evidence_used: Market concerns the 2028 US Presidential Election, ~3 years out
Candidate (Youngkin) is a low-probability, undeclared contender
No imminent catalyst tied to any liquid asset
uncertainty_notes: Long-dated political markets are thin and dominated by noise
No clear transmission channel from a single 2028 candidate's odds to 12h asset prices
If a major declaration or scandal drove the move, sector-specific effects could emerge, but not within this window reliably

llm_justification.summary: This is a far-dated, low-probability 2028 presidential candidate market with no imminent resolution or policy catalyst. A short-term swing in Youngkin's implied win probability has no reliable transmission to liquid public markets within a 12-hour window. The honest mapping is 'no tradable signal': direction unclear, confidence very low, expected magnitude near zero and well below the 700bps tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: The prediction market move is not accompanied by a market-moving real-world event
Three-year horizon dominates any equity discounting
Market is thin and prone to noise
failure_modes: A concurrent hard news catalyst (candidacy announcement, major primary shift) could move sector proxies, making the 'no signal' call wrong
The move may already reflect public information, offering no edge
SPY is a very weak proxy for any single distant candidate's odds
Attributing any SPY move to this market would be spurious correlation
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
